resources.string: Create your profile to get started. Your data stays on the device: the app works even offline.
Description: who you are and what you want to learn
E.g. physiotherapist: I want to speak with patients and colleagues in German

The AI uses this description to choose examples, exercises, lessons and vocabulary suited to you. If you work in healthcare, write it here: it is a personalization like any other. You can change it anytime.
Choose a provider and paste the key. Without a key the app still works: all offline content remains, but no tutor or AI generation.
Each profile has its own progress, separate from the others.
